text_block_list.text:
During her first three years in the 
Twinkle Series, Transcend ran wild and 
free just as she pleased—

She broadened her circle of friends. And 
then—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Furio, Espo-chan. I was thinking 
we could shoot our own independent short 
film.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? A movie? Why the heck do I gotta be 
in something like that?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Let's do it—the Funabashi promotional 
movie.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa?! Don't go deciding what's 
inside on your own!

Espoir City and Furioso. My bond with the 
two dirt Umamusume has deepened 
considerably.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, not just because it's Funabashi, but 
promo is gonna be super important going 
forward, you know?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
How about we play a cool video of us 
before the big race to get the crowd 
hyped?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Pre-race footage, huh...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Making a splash with something like that 
might be pretty cool too!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Do you have any ideas for what kind of 
movie it should be?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Of course I have an idea~. What I want to 
take with the three of us is...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"A spy action story about us operating in 
secret in the urban shadows!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: How about calling it 'Wild Slash 3'?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"3"~? We haven't even had 1 or 2 yet, so 
jumping straight to 3 is a bit much, 
don'tcha think?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps... because there are three people, 
the answer is three?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yep. A trio of spy girls is a classic 
trope that's been around forever, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's get to it! Director Trainy, 
camera's on you!
choice_data_list: OK! Let's start the test shoot!

text_block_list.text:
"First, I decided to try shooting a few 
cuts with the cinema gun."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
So what, Tran? You mean we march right 
into enemy territory and raise some hell?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. Just sitting around and waiting 
isn't our style at all. So—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"—I'll just go over and play with them 
myself! How's that for an idea!?"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Huh, which means the contents of those 
classified documents were...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Fufufun-fu. Exactly. Nothing escapes me. 
Those documents are—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: A total fake, an absolute phony! Ta-daah!

Noticing something, I stopped the Cinema 
Gun for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hanya? What's up, Trainy? Tilting your 
head like that.
choice_data_list:
Why are you always looking straight at the 
camera?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the camera? Huh, was I doing 
that? Guess I've been watching too many 
detective movies.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: You're the culprit! ...Just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alright, being careful not to let that 
happen this time, let's go for the real 
thing!
And so, we began filming, but...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Alright, it's the final showdown then! As 
for the enemy spies standing in our way...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna beat the living daylights outta 
you, raaagh!!"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Even if they are intruders, now 
that they have stepped foot inside—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"You must obey city ordinances! Funabashi 
Violence Elimination Ordinance, Article 5, 
activate!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Wait, guys. Your vibe is all over the 
place. Alright, if that's how it's gonna 
be...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I'll wrap this up!!

And so, the photoshoot was temporarily 
suspended—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I've got my own way of doing 
reconnaissance. Just let me handle my turf 
war however I want!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"No, spies don't have gang turf wars. 
That's from a delinquent movie..."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I have a proposal. For now, how about we 
make it a local indie film? I have 
connections with city hall.

"A trio completely incapable of getting on 
the same page. Yet surely, they will 
continue to bring excitement and fun to 
the dirt tracks ahead."
